description: A spectrogram drawing the frequency content of its input as it arrives

params.text: Wipes the drawing and starts it again
Switches the spectrogram on and off

menu: Window function — the window applied before the transform: None, Hamming, Hann, Bartlett or Blackman
Color mode Jet — draws the spectrogram in the Jet scheme, with Color mode Jet 2, Color mode 2, Color mode 3, Color mode BLACK and Color mode WHITE as the others
